title: ContentChromeFacingView
description: Every reading the protocol chrome (chip and page-info cards) shows for one EPR content record — GET /api/v1/epr/{id}/chrome, and the island of the storage peer's own /apps shell. Folded by elohim_facings::folds::content_chrome from the record and the projections it composes (holders: the resilience snapshot via build_felt_status; claims: attestations by subject; legs: epr_coupling; steward: stewardship allocations). Source of truth: the Notarized content record (DHT, Category A) and those projections; this view itself is Ephemeral (Operational, Category C) — recomputed per request, never stored. Not-selected contract: a lens the facing did not compute is ABSENT from the wire, never null and never zero. That absence has one provenance — this peer did not take that reading (holders: no snapshot; legs: no EPR atom names the record; app: not an html5-app) — so a bare optional is honest (CONVENTIONS rule 11). claims and steward are always selected: an empty list is a measured 'none recorded'.

recordId.description: The record id — the EPR address the chrome links back to (/epr/<id>).

format.description: The record's contentFormat, verbatim (a lamad manifest format, e.g. html5-app).

mode.description: Mirrors chrome-context contentIsland.mode: data, never inferred from bytes. trustful for every protocol record this facing reads.

witness.description: Mirrors chrome-context contentIsland.witness: green once a conductor other than the record's author holds the record as valid (and the record carries a non-blank dht_anchor_hash); amber until then, and whenever the serving peer cannot read that in time. The anchor alone is not a witness. Derived on every read, never written.

computedAt.description: RFC 3339 time this peer folded the facing.

contentAddress.description: The bundle's content address as CIDv1 (bafkrei…, the X-Content-Address spelling). ABSENT (never null) when the record names no bytes.

app.title: ContentChromeAppLens
app.description: An app bundle's body declarations (html5-app, and spa-bundle — a wrapper's format, whose body is the same app-bundle shape), read by lamad-types Html5AppBody's lenient parser (an unknown capability is never granted). presents marks a wrapper. ABSENT (never null) for any other format.

entry.description: The entry file, declared or index.html.

capabilities.description: Declared frame capabilities in declared order; [] when none.

presents.description: true when the bundle is a wrapper that presents other content and fulfils the chrome's claims.

sources.description: Origins (scheme://host[:port]) the record declares the app may reach beyond its own (html5-app-body sources, normalized by lamad-types) — what its content is observed against with a Report-Only policy; not a grant. ABSENT (never null, never []) when the record declares none.

themeHint.title: ContentChromeThemeHint
themeHint.description: The ambient theme the bundle asks for. ABSENT (never null) when undeclared.

fallbackUrl.description: Where the same work lives outside the protocol. ABSENT (never null) when undeclared.

holders.title: ContentChromeHoldersLens
holders.description: The holders reading, worded by the resiliency fold (build_felt_status) — the same snapshot the trust-mark dial reads. ABSENT (never null) when this peer could not take the snapshot.
Households holding the record now (0 is a reading, never absent).

target.description: Households the record's resilience floor wants.

asOf.description: RFC 3339 time this peer took the reading.

commitmentBackedCollectives.description: Distinct collectives holding the record under an ACTIVE provide commitment covering its reach — held by notarized promise, not only by bytes (the trust mark's sealed state). The same snapshot's resilience-snapshot-view commitmentBackedCollectives.

heldBy.description: The collectives holding the record (the shape of resilience-snapshot-view feltStatus.heldBy items).

label.description: Display label; absent when the collective has none.

intraHubPeers.description: Distinct agents within the collective holding the record; absent when not selected.

claims.title: ContentChromeClaimsLens
claims.description: The Claims reading: attestations whose subject is the record (asked by record id and by bundle CID, as the EPR page asks), newest first. Always selected; [] is a measured 'none recorded'.

revoked.description: true when withdrawn; kept listed so the withdrawal is visible.

expiresAt.description: Expiry, when the attestation carries one; absent otherwise.

legs.description: The record's EPR coupling legs (epr_content fold_coupling_legs; the shape of epr-raw-view coupling). ABSENT (never null) when no EPR atom names the record; within it a leg with no coupling is null.

steward.title: ContentChromeStewardLens
steward.description: Who stewards the record: active stewardship allocations, largest share first. Always selected; [] is a measured 'none recorded'.

governanceState.description: The allocation's governance state (disputed when contested).

displayName.description: The presence's display name when this peer holds it; absent otherwise.
